summary: A builder brings a drawing that answers a neighbor’s question about what an apartment looks like from the street.
realLife: Lincoln Green’s plans gave each apartment an outside entrance and placed plantings along the edge facing existing homes.
inGame: needs: a permit case record with drawing, building, neighbor. A neighbor can point to their own house on the drawing and ask what they would see.

turns.what: The drawing settles the question about front doors but leaves a neighbor looking straight into the parking lot.
turns.pulledBy: The neighbor's house faces the other edge of the site.
turns.writesBack: The minutes identify the edge that still needs screening.
